thread:
Marina Li: quick sync — we need a decision on what tenant admins vs regular members can see in customer-facing audit logs. also cc'ing infra: how do we sign events with KMS without leaking keys?

Sanjay Patel: my take — split visibility into three buckets: `admin_audit` (org-level changes, billing, role grants), `member_activity` (resource-level ops, files, prompts), and `system` (deploys, infra alerts). admins get `admin_audit` + `system` for their tenant, members only get `member_activity` for resources they have access to. :+1:

Carol Singh: agree with buckets. we should add an explicit `visibility` field to the schema and an `actor_role` enum so downstream UI can filter reliably. also add `kms_signature` and `schema_version`. sample event: 
```json
{
  "schema_version": "audit_event_v2",
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "actor_id": "u-987",
  "actor_role": "member",
  "visibility": "member_activity",
  "action": "model.generate",
  "resource": "/projects/p-1/models/gpt-4x",
  "outcome": "success",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T15:22:10Z",
  "kms_signature": "MEUCIQD...base64...",
  "redacted": ["prompt_text"]
}
```

Bob Martin: hold up on full event payloads to customers. PROMPT_TEXT and embeddings are PII/secret for many customers. we should default redact `prompt_text` and `input_blobs` unless tenant opts into sharing. also need a customer-visible validation endpoint so they can verify `kms_signature` and schema version. :eyes:

Dave (infra): KMS plan: sign with customer-bound keypair stored in HSM (KMS). we will never export private key. server will call `kms.sign(payload_digest)` and store signature in `kms_signature`. rotation: store `key_id` in event and publish a JWKS-like endpoint per-tenant for verification. signature scheme: `RSASSA-PSS-SHA256` for now.

Marina Li: question about RBAC enforcement — do we gate audit reads behind an API scope like `audit.read:tenant=<tenant_id>` or a more granular `audit.read:visibility=member_activity`?

Sanjay Patel: both. scoped tokens can include multiple claims: `audits:read:tenant=t-123` + `audits:visibility=admin_audit,system`. tokens for console admins get elevated visibility. API should short-circuit and return 403 if token claims don't cover the requested visibility.

Carol Singh: migration note — dual-write v1 and v2 for 8 weeks behind `feature.audit_v2` flag. consumers should read `schema_version` and fallback to v1 parsing when missing. add integration tests that hit the verification endpoint with real KMS-signed examples.

Bob Martin: vulnerability angle — if a tenant admin can request logs for arbitrary resources, we need additional checks to prevent cross-tenant signal leakage via correlated metadata (e.g., identical model IDs used across tenants). proposal: canonicalize resource identifiers with tenant namespace and enforce `resource.tenant_id == token.tenant_id` for `member_activity` queries.

Dave (infra): we'll add query-layer guards and an allowlist for `admin_audit` endpoints. also adding rate-limits and query-size caps to stop exfil attempts.

Marina Li: test plan / customer-facing validation: 1) small CLI `audit-validate` that fetches a signed event, verifies `kms_signature` against tenant JWKS, checks schema fields and ensures `redacted` list doesn't include `prompt_text` unless tenant opted-in; 2) automated fuzz tests that try to request visibility beyond token claims; 3) docs for customers showing how to verify signatures and expected fields.

Carol Singh: I'll draft schema PR with `visibility`, `actor_role`, `key_id`, `kms_sig_alg`, `kms_signature`, `redacted` array, and migration guidance. will include example curl verification: 
```bash
# verify signature using tenant JWKS (pseudo)
curl -s https://tenant-a.jwks.example/keys | jq .
# use audit-validate to check event
./audit-validate --event evt_01F... --jwks https://tenant-a.jwks.example/keys
```

audit-bot: security-scan: no high-severity regressions found in draft schema PR #4821 (scan-id: scan-2026-03-19-09). :white_check_mark:

Bob Martin: next steps from sec: 1) block-level: add `visibility` enforcement and redaction defaults, 2) infra: KMS signing + per-tenant JWKS, 3) product: update console to only show events per visibility + show signature status in UI. I'll take 1) with Carol.

Marina Li: perfect. can we target a design doc by EOD Fri and a staging spike next week?

Sanjay Patel: yes — I'll reserve infra time for the KMS spike Tues/Wed.

Carol Singh: will open the draft schema PR today.

Marina Li: thanks everyone. tagging follow-ups: @Sanjay Patel (KMS spike), @Carol Singh (schema PR + tests), @Bob Martin (sec review + redaction rules).

Dave (infra): will add ticket for tenant JWKS endpoint and rotation playbook.

Marina Li: closing loop — if anyone sees an edge-case (e.g., partner shared resources, cross-tenant admin roles), paste it here and we'll add to the matrix. :pray:
